   |
16 |             vec.release(names, memory) -- error: below views names
   |                         ^^^^^
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/for-source-held-in-outer-loop/main.ldn:15:13

   |             ^^^^^ the live derived view
  = note: [0800]/[0830]: the `inout` parameter `value` locks its argument whether or not the routine writes it; finish with `below` before the call and take it again after, or, if the routine only reads it, declare `value` without `inout`
